v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: The Lord hath inclined * his ear unto me.

text.la: Vota mea * Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo eius.
text.en: I will pay my vows * in the sight of all his people.
I have cried to the Lord, * and he hath heard me.

text.la: Auxílium meum * a Dómino, qui fecit cælum et terram.
text.en: My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

text.la: Lætátus sum * in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi. ‡
text.en: I rejoiced * at the things that were said to me. ‡

text.la: Qui me misit * mecum est, et non relíquit me solum; quia quæ plácita sunt ei, fácio semper.
text.en: He That sent Me is with Me, * and hath not left Me alone, for I do always those things that please Him.

text.la: Adésto supplicatiónibus nostris, omnípotens Deus: et, quibus fidúciam sperándæ pietátis indúlges; consuétæ misericórdiæ tríbue benígnus efféctum.
text.en: Graciously hear our prayers, O Almighty God, and as Thou dost give us to look with confidence for thy favour for which we hope, so grant us, in thy goodness, the manifestation of thine accustomed mercy.

office.title: Feria Secunda infra Hebd II in Quadr
